race.comment: SUM INVICTUS (5) is hard to look past after overcoming a hold-up and interference at the 300m to stretch out strongly when clear to win by a length. The shorter 1050m is the only query, but the way he let down last start is too irresistible to ignore. JUNGLE WARRIOR (9) was better than the bare sixth indicates first-up after racing wide throughout. Drawn sticky again but with a touch of luck and added fitness he can play a more significant role. QICKWIT (15) is a genuine danger on his Gatton second, beaten a head as favourite after being steadied. His record at this track and distance, plus the rider combination, keeps him firmly in calculations. STEFFI ELECTRICA (7) resumes off a strong last campaign, having won at Grafton then run Beer Baron to just over half a length at Coffs. Races best when sent forward, so expect KWT to do exactly that from the low draw. PUROSANGUE (10) will also inject good speed and could sneak a minor spot.
